firstExample.en: After extensive deliberations, the executive committee reached a consensus regarding the revised budget allocation for the upcoming fiscal year.
firstExample.zh: 經過深入的討論後，執行委員會就即將到來的財政年度之修訂預算分配達成了共識。

results.prompt: A high-end, modern corporate boardroom flooded with soft, natural daylight from floor-to-ceiling windows overlooking a city skyline. A diverse group of professional executives in tailored business attire are seated around a sleek oval conference table. They are nodding and smiling, showing visible agreement, with a senior manager warmly shaking hands with a colleague across the table. On the table are modern laptops, minimalist glass water carafes, and neat financial charts. High-end commercial photography style, 8k resolution, sharp focus, elegant glass and wood textures, authentic corporate atmosphere, professional lighting.
